traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are satisfied:
- **Before Other Tags / After Other Tags / Mixed Positions**: The `valid-annotation-format` tests include dedicated valid cases that place `@story`/`@req` before, after, and interleaved with `@param`/`@returns` tags, all passing. - **Proper Termination & JSDoc Tag Detection**: `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine` treats any line starting with `@` (except `@story`, `@req`, `@supports`) as a JSDoc boundary. `processCommentLine` finalizes any pending `@story`/`@req` when such a line is seen, preventing concatenation like `REQ-OPTIMIZATION@param{object}data`. - **Continuation Lines & Preserve Multiline**: Continuation of multi-line annotation values only happens when there is a pending annotation and the normalized line is not another JSDoc tag; multi-line `@story` before `@param` is tested and passes, confirming `REQ-CONTINUATION-LOGIC` and `REQ-PRESERVE-MULTILINE`. - **No False Positives & Error Messages**: The `[REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES]` test ensures valid JSDoc tags following `@req` do not corrupt the requirement ID. Error message behavior for genuinely invalid formats is already covered by existing tests for `invalidStoryFormat` and `invalidReqFormat`, and all of those still pass, indicating no regressions. - **Backward Compatibility**: The full Jest suite passes, including many pre-existing tests for `valid-annotation-format`, showing that the new coexistence logic did not break earlier behaviors. - **Documentation**: `docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md` now has a dedicated **JSDoc coexistence** section with an example using `docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md` that matches the intended behavior.
Given the targeted tests tied to this story, the implemented boundary-detection and continuation logic, the updated documentation, and a fully passing test run, this story is fully implemented.
